transkript.t: The top 1% of tech builders aren't using standard commercial apps anymore.
They're running their whole operations on modular open source repos.
Open HiggsField replaces HiggsField for AI image and video generation.
Voice Studio replaces 11 Labs runs 100% locally on your own machine.
Open SEO replaces SEMrush for Rank Tracking, Backlinks and Site Audits.
App Flowey replaces Notion and works with local models.
Open Whisper replaces WhisperFlow so you can dictate into any app online or offline.
Open Project, the open source Asana killer.
Cal.com replaces Calendly with full Google and Outlook calendar syncing.
Chatroot replaces Intercom to manage every customer lead in one inbox.
Cap replaces Loom for open source screen recording.
Comment repo and I'll send you all nine links.
